proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3413 kūrpara gives Pali kappara, Prakrit kuppara/koppara, Marathi kopar and Konkani khoppōru elbow. Selected eastern kopor/kopor-like and Khandesi kopura forms fit this r-final elbow family with vowel and aspiration variation retained. This distinguishes them from the nasal kaphoṇi family. The dictionary discusses competing directions of Dravidian contact; no direct donor route is asserted. Exact response: kopura.
